Home / Organization
Dashboard

Organization — See your projects, department by department.

Register a department tree and assign projects to it, and you can track progress by department or filter the cross-space view by department. Organization data is stored only in your browser and never sent anywhere else.

A department tree with flexible parent/child structure

Just pick a parent department and type a name to add a department at any depth. Reorder, collapse, and delete departments too.

Switch between a list view and a graphical org chart

An org-chart mode with boxes and connector lines visualizes your department structure

Assign projects to departments for analysis

Just assign a department from a dropdown on the Data Management tab, and it's ready to use in department-based project analysis and the cross-space department filter.

Roll up child and grandchild departments together

Pick a department and it aggregates progress rate, overdue hours, and more across that department and all its sub-departments.

Organization data is stored locally in your browser

It's never synced with Backlog or across accounts, so you can safely register your company's actual org structure as-is. Export/import lets you carry it to another PC too.

Know exactly where each department stands.

Build the org tree once, then just link projects to it. See the status of every department at a glance, anytime.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. 8 views and a project dashboard make daily task management and team progress tracking easier.
